messages:
anna: heads-up — saw a weird cross-org artifact on the Insights dashboard when doing rapid org-switching. looks like some panels showed metrics for the previously-open org for ~2s before fixing up.
mike: ugh, can you repro? steps?
anna: yep. steps: 1) open org A insights, 2) open org B in a second tab, 3) alt+tab back to A, click refresh on a saved panel. sometimes the panel flashes rows for B for a split second.
jordan: hmm that sounds like a stale prefetch / KV cache mismatch combined with routing header not being applied to the render RPC. any logs?
anna: pasted a quick capture: ```GET /internal/console/panel/render 200 OK
headers: x-org-id: A, x-route-affinity: fast
response.start: uses cached kv-prefix: org:B:panel:42
rendered_rows: [ {org_id: B, count: 243}, ... ]
``` so header was A but cached prefix pointed to B.
sam: that implies cache key uses user session scope instead of tenant scope. maybe the prefetched tile writer didn't namespace on workspaceId when saving to the shared edge cache.
mike: @sam can you pull up the prefetched tile code in edge-prefetch service? I remember a recent refactor to move prefix computation to middleware.
sam: looking now. I can see middleware sets cache_key = `${userId}:${panelId}` in 98-prefetch branch — wrong. should be `${orgId}:${panelId}`. maybe fallthrough added userId for faster invalidation but broke tenant isolation.
jordan: oof. why did tests not catch this? our unit tests stubbed cache and used single-tenant fixtures. need an integration test exercising two org sessions in parallel.
anna: repro rate ~30% on my laptop under quick switching. repro less if rate-limited. also noticed quota/route-awareness telemetry shows spikes when this happens.
console-monitor-bot: anomaly detected: panel-render-latency spike (p95) in prod-canary at 2024-10-09T11:02:13Z — +220ms, affected tenants: 12 (possible cache thrash).
mike: plan: 1) hotfix to namespace by orgId in prefetch writer (patch + canary), 2) add multi-tenant parallel integration test, 3) add a defensive assert in render path validating cache key org matches request org.
jordan: agree. also recommend adding a quick rollout guard: when canary sees any cross-tenant sample in 1h, auto-roll back.
sam: I'll open the PR for the hotfix now. will include repro steps and a small harness using puppeteer to simulate fast tab switches.
anna: thank you. also can we surface a temporary console-level warning when a panel detects a mismatch? would help CS triage.
mike: yes — add a telemetry tag `panel_org_mismatch:true` and surface in the per-panel debug drawer (dev only). not to be shown to customers.
deploy-bot: build pipeline: patch/edge-prefetch#789 -> build started
sam: PR up: https://git.internal/redwood/edge-prefetch/pull/789
sam: patch changes 3 lines, adds namespacing and a unit test.
jordan: adding integration test to eng-platform/integration/fast-switch.test.js — will mock two org cookies and hammer the refresh endpoint concurrently.
mike: @sam once CI passes let's canary to staging-canary and run anna's repro harness for 30min.
anna: running harness now against staging-canary.
console-monitor-bot: staging-canary: no anomalies detected in first 15m. p95 latency stable.
anna: after 12m I still see 0/50 repros. will keep running for another 15m.
sam: merged to staging-canary, backport queued for prod-hotfix branch.
mike: also file a follow-up to audit other cache writers — search for `:${userId}:` patterns in codebase.
anna: opened ticket ENG-4572 audit cache namespace patterns.
jordan: good. long-term we should enforce a lint rule forbidding non-tenant prefixes in shared caches.
mike: agreed. add to eng-infra board.
deploy-bot: prod hotfix roll started at 2024-10-09T13:40:05Z -> rolling to 3 pods then 30% then 100%.
console-monitor-bot: prod: anomaly cleared, no panel_org_mismatch events after deploy. Monitor window: 2h.
anna: verified on a few accounts — no ghost rows. thanks team.
mike: postmortem: short writeup please — include root cause (prefetch cache key used userId), impact (brief cross-tenant flashes, telemetry spikes), remediation (hotfix, tests, lint), rollback/rollout timeline, and preventative actions (audit + lint + integration tests).
anna: will draft and link here.
anna: draft posted: https://docs.internal/redwood/postmortems/ENG-4572-draft
sam: nice. closing thread after postmortem merged.
anna: :thumbsup:
